dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-c", "print('Cataclysm-DDA Python dependencies container ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for stability. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies from requirements.txt, and sets a default command indicating container readiness. The WORKDIR and COPY instructions set up the application environment appropriately.
